data.name: Nikhila
data.gender_notes: Nikhila is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nikhila is a Sanskrit name meaning 'complete' or 'all-pervading'. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the god Vishnu pervades and protects the universe in its entirety, represented by the name Nikhila. The name signifies the idea of being all-encompassing, all-knowing, and all-powerful. The name Nikhila carries the meaning “Complete, All-pervading” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nikhila usually hope their child will grow to embody complete, all-pervading and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the divine presence in all aspects of life
data.etymology: Nikhila belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Complete, All-pervading.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nikhila total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nikhila carries a deep cultural significance in Hinduism. It is a name that symbolizes the divine nature of being and the idea of completeness. The name Nikhila is believed to bring blessings of wholeness, fulfillment, and protection. It is also a popular name for children, extending beyond cultural boundaries due to its universal appeal.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu mythology, Nikhila is a reflection of the divine qualities of the god Vishnu. The name carries spiritual significance as it relates to the concept of Brahman, the ultimate reality, which is all-pervading and omnipresent. By embracing the name Nikhila, one might be reminded of their innate connection to the divine, and strive to live a life that embodies completeness and wholeness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nikhila means "all pervading" or "omnipresent" in Sanskrit. It symbolizes the divine essence that exists in everything and is beyond limitations. The name represents the infinite and unbounded nature of the supreme consciousness.

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'nikshipta', meaning 'given' or 'assigned'.
